subject: Information message if no data available

messages.author: f77ef228c09cb32c
messages.subject: Information message if no data available
parts:
Hi, 

I developed a shiny application where data of interest are shown with renderTable after selected input variable in sidebarPanel.

I want to send a message at user if no data are available according to choices and no error message from R console.

User can select one among three datasets in selectInput and one category among 10.  All categories are not available for all datasets. I want to send a message if user make a choice not available.


server.R


 my data <- reactive(){
     data = myfunction()
 }

 output$tableACorr <- renderTable({
data <- mydata()
if(failed condition)
          print("Information message : choice not available")
}else{
data_sort <- data[order(data[,3],decreasing=FALSE),]
head((data_sort),n=15)
}
    },include.rownames=FALSE)


Thanks for your help

Elodie

data <- checkmydata()

      return("Information message : Not Cell-lines and Xenogreffe samples for U95A-Av2 dataset")
      } else  if(data=="gene"){

      } else {
